verdict.rationale: LibreOffice's own CLI documents headless `--convert-to` conversion, with a PDF export example for .doc files, and its filter list covers Word (docx), Excel (xlsm) and PowerPoint (pptx) formats. A community user confirms running it in Docker to generate PDFs and normalize document formats. Missing for 10: explicit documented PDF export examples for Excel and PowerPoint files, and corroboration of conversion fidelity for complex Excel-specific files (one user notes caveats with corporate Excel files).

support.subject: As a power user, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files convert to PDF and between office formats

citations.quote: Also runs it in Docker to generate PDFs from templates and normalize document formats.
